quests.title: Beneath Vaelmoor
quests.summary: A hooded wanderer spoke of doors under the hills.
description: The moon over Vaelmoor has hung full and white for nine nights. The wanderer on the cottage path says something below the hills is holding it there.
The old barrows have doors. Some of them, the wanderer says, go down further than they should.

objectives.text: Speak with the hooded wanderer on the cottage path

quests.title: The Forgetting
quests.summary: Hollowford is forgetting itself, and its chapel bell has gone quiet.
description: Since the moon stopped, the people of Hollowford have been losing things that cannot be dropped: names, faces, the way to their own front doors. Sir Aldric, who kept the town for thirty years, no longer knows his own house.
The chapel bell was rung every night to call the sleeping back. Its clapper was carried off the night the moon stopped, and nobody has rung it since.

objectives.text: Speak with Brother Cass at the chapel
Recover the bell clapper from the barrow door
Bring the clapper to Brother Cass
Speak with Sir Aldric by the well

quests.title: Bram's Stash
quests.summary: Old Bram hid something behind the chapel, and is afraid he will forget where.
description: Bram drinks at the Barrow's Back every night that the moon allows, which lately is every night. For the price of a mead he told you about a box he hid years ago, behind the chapel, under the woodpile.
He says it is yours if you can open it. He says he would only drink it.

objectives.text: Find the box under the woodpile behind the chapel

quests.title: The Conclave Gathers
quests.summary: The wizards of the Gloaming have gathered at the old house beyond Lanternholt.
description: Lanterns burn in the windows of Lanternholt, but nobody there remembers lighting them. An old man by the road said the wizards have gathered again at the Conclave House, as they do only when something below begins to wake.
If anyone knows why the sky over the Gloaming never brightens, it is them.

objectives.text: Speak with Archmage Velloran at the Conclave House
Seek the Pale Wanderer by the dark water
Walk the road to Vaelmoor Keep

quests.title: The Keeper's Price
quests.summary: Something in the Hollow Pines wants back what it lost.
description: Among the pines where the sky runs green, a hooded thing stands guard over nothing. It does not speak, but it watches the ground in front of it as if something should be lying there.
A skull of gold was taken from that clearing long ago. Perhaps it has found its way back.

objectives.text: Find the golden skull in the Hollow Pines
Offer the skull to the Hollow Keeper

quests.title: A Light in Lanternholt
quests.summary: You woke on the road into Lanternholt.
description: You woke on the cobbles with the taste of cold iron in your mouth and no memory of the road behind you. The village ahead was lit, every window, as if it had been waiting.
